# halcyon

halcyon is a dark blue-ish color scheme that its own description compares in feel to Tokyo Night. The same description records that work on the theme is in hiatus until community rules and the linter have been sorted out. The theme index lists dark mode only.

![halcyon screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dbarenholz/halcyon-obsidian/HEAD/img/halcyon-banner-small.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "halcyon"
    author: "dbarenholz"
    repo:   "dbarenholz/halcyon-obsidian"
    slug:   "halcyon"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/halcyon"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/dbarenholz/halcyon-obsidian"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dbarenholz/halcyon-obsidian/HEAD/img/halcyon-banner-small.png"

    modes: ["dark"]
    about: "Halcyon is a dark blue-ish color scheme with pretty colors, similar in vibes to Tokyo Night. Work on the theme is currently in hiatus untill community rules and linter has been properly sorted out."
}
```
